_about: Public-domain John Colquhoun (1748-1827, Church of Scotland, minister at Leith) for the Word Hoard: 8 books from Internet Archive scans, 1814-1836, among them A Treatise on the Law and the Gospel, Treatise on the Covenant of Grace, Treatise on the Covenant of Works, A Treatise on Spiritual Comfort and View of Evangelical Repentance. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

colquhoun-spiritual-comfort-1814: A Treatise on Spiritual Comfort, second edition, corrected (Edinburgh: J. Ogle and others, 1814)
colquhoun-law-and-gospel: A Treatise on the Law and the Gospel (Edinburgh: J. Ogle and others, 1816)
colquhoun-covenant-of-grace: Treatise on the Covenant of Grace (Edinburgh: Ogle, Allardice and Thomson, and others, 1818)
colquhoun-covenant-of-works: Treatise on the Covenant of Works (Edinburgh: Thomsons, Brothers, 1821)
colquhoun-spiritual-comfort-1822: Treatise on Spiritual Comfort, third edition improved (Edinburgh: Thomsons, Brothers, 1822)
colquhoun-evangelical-repentance: View of Evangelical Repentance, from the Sacred Records (Edinburgh: Thomsons, Brothers; title-page year unreadable in the OCR, catalogued 1825)
colquhoun-promises-of-gospel: A Collection of the Promises of the Gospel, arranged under their proper heads, with Reflections and Exhortations (Edinburgh: Thomsons, Brothers, MDCCCXXV)
colquhoun-sermons: Sermons, chiefly on Doctrinal Subjects, posthumous (Edinburgh: J. and D. Collie for W. Whyte and others, 1836)
